assets.prompt: Create a single production-ready background image asset for a minimalist premium Texas Hold'em video game UI. Widescreen landscape 16:9, full bleed, no frame. Art direction: tactile understated dark forest-green luxury stationery, not a casino photograph. Base is almost-black teal #091719 to deep evergreen #13382F with beautiful very fine natural paper/leather grain, broad soft grazing emerald light from the upper right. A restrained abstract composition of large overlapping curved dark-green planes and soft architectural shadows occupies only the extreme right and lower edges; one or two exceedingly fine muted champagne-gold curved inlay lines near the upper-right and bottom-right corner. The entire left half and central 70 percent must remain dark, quiet, very low contrast, clean negative space for cream typography and UI panels. Keep the right side dark enough for UI overlay as well. Premium, calm, contemporary, elegant, subtle material depth; enough visible texture and asymmetry to distinguish from a plain gradient, no coarse noise, no glow particles. Flat orthographic artwork, no perspective environment, no photographic objects. Absolutely no lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, cards, poker chips, buttons or UI mockup. This is one reusable background texture, not an image of a complete screen.

Create one production-ready full-bleed texture image of a luxurious deep emerald green poker table felt for a minimalist video game. Wide landscape rectangle, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Entire image is ONLY flat green felt material from a perfectly perpendicular top-down orthographic view: no table outline, no rail, no border, no seams, no folds, no objects, no playing cards, no chips, no symbols, no text, no watermark. Rich muted forest emerald palette around #164838, #1B5140 and #123B30. Very fine short velvet fibers and subtle organic weave visible at close inspection, refined real tactile material, evenly scaled across the surface. Gentle broad diffuse light across the upper-middle, subdued darker edges, very low contrast so cream text and playing cards remain clearly readable. Mostly consistent middle-dark green, not black, not shiny, no gritty coarse noise, no strong spotlight or deep vignette. Minimal contemporary premium card-room aesthetic. This is a reusable game surface texture, not a UI mockup or a photograph of a room.

Generate one reusable material texture for the face of a minimalist premium poker game's primary button. Wide landscape rectangle about 4:1, full bleed, entirely filled with a refined matte satin aluminum material. Neutral white/silver grayscale ONLY, because the game will tint it champagne gold at runtime. The surface is pale warm-neutral gray to white, values mostly #E0E0E0 through #FCFCFC, with extremely fine horizontal brushed metal grain, a soft broad diffused highlight along the upper third, and a slight smooth falloff toward the bottom. Very subtle and flat, no reflective mirror effects, no hard shine, no bevel, no drop shadow, no outline, no rounded corners, no edges, no borders, no geometry; the engine will provide the rounded clipping shape. No letters, no text, no labels, no icons, no objects, no watermark, no UI layout. This is only a full-bleed lightly brushed silvery material swatch, not a finished button or a picture of a button. Keep it clean and understated, appropriate under dark readable text.
